it_helpdesk.title: Corporate VPN Troubleshooting
it_helpdesk.content: Reset GlobalProtect VPN by signing out, clearing cached credentials in Keychain/Credential Manager, and re-authenticating with Okta MFA. If error 403 persists, request VPN-Users group access via IT ticket.

it_helpdesk.title: Password Reset Policy
it_helpdesk.content: Passwords expire every 180 days. Use https://id.acme.internal/reset with Okta Verify push. Minimum 14 characters, no reuse of last 5 passwords.

policies.title: 2026 Procurement & Software Spend Policy
policies.content: Purchases under $2,000 require manager approval. Purchases between $2,000 and $10,000 require VP Finance sign-off and must preserve at least $5,000 in operating cash buffer after upcoming 14-day payables. Purchases over $10,000 require CFO approval.
